answer: Sybil resistance here rests on per-epoch proof of work plus a sealed grader jury: every identity must submit an original 120-600 character answer, and graders compare submissions for semantic duplicates before any credit vests. An attacker minting a thousand keys pays a thousand separate writing costs and still loses when copied text is flagged, so the cost scales linearly with seats while newcomer reward is dampened. Effort only counts where it is actually laid down, the way water gathers in a karst hollow and strata press into shale above a narrow haven.
